reasons: The narrowed claim adds the equal-arm condition required by its numerical variance and records \(\pi\) in the dependency metadata.

narrow: The displayed variance equals the random-arm conditional-multinomial variance only when \(\pi_1=1/2\); for general positive \(\pi_1\) it is \((1/8-t_0^2)/\pi_1\). Clipping also makes \(S_{\widehat t}\) well typed on every sample while being asymptotically inactive at an interior \(t_0\).
The narrowed claim separates the polyhedral nonempty branch from the symbolic all-compact-sets fallback while retaining the original dependencies and declared computational outputs.

narrow: In the empty-intersection fallback, \(\mathcal H_n\) contains every nonempty compact subset of the policy cube. Arbitrary compact sets need not be finite unions of polytopes, so the frozen representation clause is false on that branch. The narrowed claim preserves the exact symbolic fallback and both exact radii, and limits the finite-union representation clause to the nonempty branch where every member is generated by finitely many allocation polytopes.

verdict.note: Accepted all three consulted changes. The repeated DID NOT LAND payload is safely omitted because its sole positive-arm-share dependency correction already landed on main as commit d32c097f8759; statement and continuity theorem remain unchanged.
